name: Reach Cascade — comms-policy v1 enforcer
description: Notification cascade across web-push → apex-apple-bridge → telegram → discord → imessage → sms-bridge → voice → digest. Each attempter writes the per-channel reach-ledger so future cascades rank by recency. Quiet-hours filter, anti-spam dedupe, openclaw-native send with raw-API fallback. Salvages chuck-comms-cascade.mjs into a typed openclaw skill.

telegramChatId.label: Telegram chat id
telegramChatId.help: Numeric chat id Joseph receives signed notifications on.

imessageBuddy.label: Default iMessage / SMS recipient
imessageBuddy.help: E.164 phone number or Apple ID. Used by both the imessage and sms-bridge channels.

policyPath.label: Comms-policy path
policyPath.help: Absolute or ~-relative JSON file containing per-tier cascade overrides. Falls back to defaults when absent.

openclawCliPath.label: openclaw CLI entrypoint
openclawCliPath.help: Path to the openclaw dist entry. Used to invoke `message send` for the gateway-routed Telegram + Discord paths.
